question: In October 2020, the world's longest highway tunnel was inaugurated in the state of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi **inaugurated **the **Atal Tunnel**, Rohtang in **Himachal Pradesh **on **3rd October 2020**.
 
• **Atal Tunnel** is the **longest highway tunnel **in the **World**.
 
• The** 9.02 Km long tunnel **connects **Manali **to **Lahaul**-**Spiti **valley **throughout the year**.
 
• It is a **horseshoe-shaped**, single tube double lane tunnel with a **roadway of 8 Mtrs**.
 
• It has an **overhead clearance of 5.525 Mtrs**.
 
• The Tunnel has ample **safety features **built into it. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Important railway tunnel:

 
 
• The longest railway tunnel in the world is the Gotthard base tunnel in Switzerland.
 
• Seikan Tunnel is 53 Km long and situated in Japan.
 
• Yulhyeon Tunnel is 50 Km long and situated in South Korea.
 
• Channel Tunnel is situated on the English Channel on Dover strait.
